name: SAM E51 Curiosity Nano (EV76S68A)
description: Breadboard-friendly SAME51J20A (120 MHz Cortex-M4F, 1 MB flash, CAN-FD, USB) board with a built-in debugger and virtual COM port for evaluating the SAM E5x family.
notes: Price is Newark's listing ($24.99); a DigiKey bulk-packaging listing appeared at about $10 but looked inconsistent. Microchip's page was not fetchable, so features other than the SAME51J20A MCU rely on the product family.
Curiosity Nano boards are minimal: CAN-FD pins are on the headers but no CAN transceiver is fitted (add one externally). Board size and GPIO count are estimates.
